records.title: Learning to Optimize through Solver-Grounded Self-Play
records.reason: OPT-Zero is a self-play training framework for optimization modeling; the abstract focuses on training data and problem-solving capability.

records.title: Dr.Credit: Rubric-Grounded Process Credit Assignment for Deep Research Agents
records.reason: Dr.Credit develops process credit assignment for training deep-research agents; it does not report inference-time cost reduction.

records.title: Unbiased Top-$k$ Estimation for On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: Unbiased Top-k Estimation improves gradient estimation in on-policy distillation; it targets post-training computation, not inference efficiency.

records.title: ReproBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Reproducing Vulnerability From Scratch
records.reason: ReproBench benchmarks end-to-end vulnerability reproduction by LLM agents; its contribution is cybersecurity evaluation rather than inference optimization.

records.title: CoDeL: Co-Evolutionary Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM-based Agents
records.reason: CoDeL trains an LLM-agent prompt-injection defense via co-evolution and LoRA; the abstract reports safety/training outcomes, not inference efficiency.
